attributes.name: Warmonger Wasp
attributes.powers:
The Warmonger Wasp is immune to the Attack and Mental traits.

Before you act, the Warmonger Wasp deals 1d4 Electricity damage to you.

While you act, all damage dealt by the Warmonger Wasp is Poison damage.

This construct is an amalgam of protoplasmic flesh and pure chaos.
